plugins.name: burn-meter
plugins.description: Live pane showing session spend, $/h burn rate with a 1-hour sparkline, an optional budget with alerts, tokens and estimated cost per model, context fill and rate-limit reset countdowns.

plugins.name: file-trail
plugins.description: Live repo file tree that lights up each file and folder Claude reads, edits, writes or searches, as it happens. Opens only the branches Claude touched, with R/E/W/S marks and counts.
